key: bio:v3:Supriya Lifescience Ltd:Change in Management:Board approved Q2 FY27 unaudited results and appointed Mangesh Vaze as COO from November 6, 2026.

people.name: Mangesh Vaze
background: B.E. in Chemical Engineering and Executive MBA (strategy, marketing, finance)
Approximately 34 years of experience in production, process engineering, API manufacturing and operations

Previously held senior positions at Zydus Lifescience Ltd., Cipla Ltd., Mylan Laboratories Ltd., Apotex Pharmachem India Pvt Ltd, Wockhardt Ltd., Orchid Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. and Lupin Ltd.

value.why_it_matters: The appointment of an experienced pharma operations executive as COO may strengthen Supriya Lifescience’s manufacturing and API production capabilities.
